text:
nate: Heads-up: release pipeline blocked by regendiff guard. It flagged a minor bump because CHANGELOG headers got reordered during regen.

claire: Can you show the regendiff snippet?

nate: Sure — small excerpt: 
```diff
-### Bugfixes
-
-- fix: auth retry doc typo
+### Enhancements
+
+note: add auto-retry mention for SDKs
```
The guard treats 'Enhancements' as a minor. This is only docs churn.

omar: Weird — we recently merged a codegen change that stable-sorts changelog fragments (commit a1b2c3d). That could change ordering across regenerations.

release-bot: regendiff-check failed at 1745010000. Log: https://ci.internal/redwood/ci/regen/5678. Reason: semver bump inferred: minor.

nia: Also seeing unrelated flaky failure in the Go sample app tests after regen — auth integration test now observes more retries. Test expects 1 retry on 401; now it's 3.\nTest snippet:
```go
// expect single retry for transient 401
if got := retries; got != 1 { t.Fatalf("want 1 retry; got %d", got) }
```
Locally using the previous typegen artifact makes the test pass.

claire: So two things: changelog ordering causing semver bump, and a change in SDK retry defaults. Are they related to the same PR?

omar: They are both downstream of typegen/codegen changes. The stable-sort affects changelog output; a separate defaults change (commit b7c4f2e) adjusted generator retry defaults for Go. Looks like the generator default moved from 1 -> 3.

nate: Can someone run `typegen --inspect` on the old/new artifacts and paste the retry config?

nia: I ran it. Diff: 
```yaml
- retry_policy:
-   max_retries: 1
+ retry_policy:
+   max_retries: 3
```
So Go generator default bumped to 3. That explains test failures.

claire: Changing defaults for a language is a behavioral change and should have been coordinated. We need to treat that as at least a minor semantics change if it's a default behavioral change across SDKs.

omar: Agreed. For immediate unblock I propose: (A) temporarily pin typegen artifact in release workflow, (B) patch regendiff-check to ignore CHANGELOG.md and docs/release-only diffs when computing semver, (C) open follow-up with codegen owners about retry default.

nate: I'm +1 on pin for today's publish. I'll add a step in the publish job to fetch the last-green typegen hash if regendiff-check fails on docs-only.

claire: For regendiff-check patch: simplest quick fix is to filter the file list before semver inference: `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep -vE "^(CHANGELOG.md|docs/releases/)"`. I'll draft a tiny PR to the release guard.

release-bot: Created ticket INF-8521: "codegen default retry change and changelog ordering cause release guard to block". Attached regendiff and test logs.

nia: I'll also open a sample-app PR that makes the auth test assert on explicit client config (config.Retry.Max == 1) rather than implicit behavior. That will decouple test from generator defaults while we decide the correct default.

omar: For medium-term: revert the default bump in generator until we have cross-SDK agreement, or gate by language-specific config. I'll draft a revert PR for commit b7c4f2e and tag codegen owners.

nate: Quick notes: we should also update the release playbook with a checklist to check for behavioral default changes in typegen/regens before release.

claire: PR to regendiff-check opened: https://phab.internal/rD/12345. Tagging @nia and @nate for review.

nia: Update 1745012000: pinned typegen artifact in publish job and re-ran — CI passed, release proceeded. Leaving a note in the release log about temporary pin and INF-8521.

nate: Thanks. Keeping this thread as the source of truth for follow-ups. We'll coordinate the post-release rollback or revert with codegen team.

claire: Adding to next devex sync agenda: changelog semantics, stable-sort implications, and cross-SDK default governance.

nia: Closing loop for now — publish unblocked.
